Rubrik Business Justification
Cyber Resilience & Data Protection Modernization
ChevronPhillips Chemical · CPChem
Why Do Anything · Why Rubrik · Why Now
Partner with Rubrik to deliver the most performant, scalable, and simple to manage cyber resilient solution for CPChem's most critical data.
!Why Do Anything
Veritas NetBackup & native Microsoft tools have created critical pain points:
  • Operational Failures at Remote Sites — Large file servers cannot complete replications within 24-hour windows; backup windows missed.
  • Antiquated Identity Protection — AD recovery relies on manual, outdated tools. Native Entra ID tools too limited for modern needs.
  • Poor Azure Recovery & Support — Significant trouble restoring Azure VMs in recent DR exercise. Veritas cloud support quality is declining.
  • Small Team, High Manual Burden — A small IT team manages a massive number of systems. Veritas environment pulls them away from strategic initiatives.
✓Why Rubrik
Consolidates protection into a single, automated, cyber-resilient platform.
  • Superior Cloud Efficiency (Azure) — Rubrik Cloud Vault provides a secure, air-gapped, immutable storage target. Logical, not physical — data cannot be encrypted or deleted by attackers.
  • 20–40% Azure Cost Savings — Exocompute (ephemeral worker nodes) eliminates expensive persistent cloud clusters or snapshots.
  • Modern Identity & OT Protection — Full forest-level orchestration and granular attribute comparison for AD/Entra ID. Replaces manual processes with rapid, automated recovery.
  • Optimized for Nutanix AHV — Designed for CPChem's new standard. Near-zero RTO via Live Mount and automated discovery/policy application for AHV VMs.
⚠Why Now
Delaying the transition increases financial & security risks.
  • September Renewal Deadline — Veritas renewal is in September. Deciding by March/April allows phased deployment through Q2/Q3, avoiding lock-in to another multi-year cycle with declining vendor support.
  • The "Luck" Factor in Cyber RTO — Recent incident met 24-hour RTO but team acknowledged they "probably got lucky." Rubrik replaces luck with guaranteed immutability and proactive anomaly detection.
  • Consolidation Savings — Moving to a single platform eliminates redundant tools and can deliver better technology at lower total cost than current "business as usual" spend.
CPChem Cyber Resilience Objectives
⚠Current Challenges
Insufficient Retention
Current 30-day window risks permanent data loss if breaches or failures go undetected.
Replication Bottlenecks
Large remote file servers fail to complete full replications within 24 hours.
Recovery Reliability

Declining Support
Veritas support quality for cloud workloads has noticeably deteriorated.
Administrative Burden
Complex Veritas environment overburdens a small IT team, diverting focus from strategic projects.
✓How Rubrik Helps · Rubrik Security Cloud
Cost · Reduced Cloud Costs
15–25% cloud bill savings vs. Azure & traditional tools. Tiering capabilities further reduce cost.
Complexity · Standardized Operations
Reliably orchestrates backup processes, eliminates manual intervention. Single unified interface. Performance & reliability at scale. Meets backup window SLA.
Cyber · Faster Ransomware Recovery
No cyber awareness or application threat surface (avg dwell time 5–7 days). Stronger platform security with immutability standard and no admin backdoors.
Decision Window: Veritas renewal in September requires a March/April decision to enable phased deployment through Q2 and Q3 2026 — avoiding another multi-year lock-in with a vendor whose cloud support is declining.
On-Prem: Veritas vs. Rubrik
Modernizing the on-premises data protection platform.
⚠Current State · Veritas
Complex Legacy Architecture
"Build your own" model relies on distinct servers, creating a Single Point of Failure and requiring advanced sizing.
Weak Cyber Resilience
Dependent on basic OS security and reactive third-party bolt-ons with manual thresholds causing false positives.
Operational Burden
Fragmented consoles required for management, coupled with a nightmarish component-by-component upgrade sequence.
Cloud & Compliance Gaps
Cloud IaaS backups are not immutable, remain vulnerable to takeover, and lack native posture management.
✓Future State · Rubrik
Modern Unified Architecture
Scale-out, masterless architecture eliminates SPOFs. Managed globally via a single SaaS control plane.
Unmatched Cyber Resilience
Immutable by default (Native Air Gap) with Zero Trust Security and a cyber recovery guarantee.
Intelligent & Rapid Recovery
Seamless rolling upgrades alongside automated Clean Rooms and orchestrated playbooks for safe failover.
Future-Proof Platform
Unified posture management natively secures sensitive data, SaaS environments (M365), and Identity systems.
Azure Cloud: Native vs. Rubrik
Modernizing Azure workload protection — VMs, SQL, Files, and Blob.
⚠Current State · Azure Native
Fragmented Visibility
Aggregated views require stitching together multiple tools, making it extremely difficult to verify hybrid coverage.
Hidden & Unpredictable Costs
Moving VM recovery points to the archive tier converts incrementals to full backups, severely inflating capacity costs.
Weak Cyber Posture
Immutable Vaults can be toggled off or misconfigured. Threat monitoring lacks deep blast-radius analysis.
Limited Recovery Capabilities
Searches are limited to single snapshots. Cross-region exports and cross-subscription restores are restricted and slow.
✓Future State · Rubrik
Unified Workload Protection
A single, automated control plane protects VMs, SQL, Blob, Files, and Nutanix Cloud on Azure — ensuring no workloads slip through the cracks.
Cost Predictability & Optimization
Automates smart lifecycle tiering to immutable vaults using incremental-forever backups to minimize storage footprint.
True Cyber Resilience
Logically air-gapped backups isolate data, utilizing machine learning and Google Mandiant intelligence for proactive hunting.
Rapid Orchestrated Recovery
Global Search finds files across all snapshots instantly. Live Mount provides near-zero RTOs anywhere in the cloud.
Cloud Strategy: Veritas/Cohesity vs Rubrik
Why Rubrik is the right choice over alternatives for cloud-era data protection.
⚠Future State · Veritas / Cohesity
Chaotic Management
Environments feel like operating disjointed point solutions rather than a unified data protection fabric.
Vulnerable to Cloud Takeovers
If the primary cloud environment is compromised by threat actors, standard backup data remains highly susceptible.
High-Stakes Recovery Guesswork
Manual recovery runbooks and brutal cycles of building/tearing down clean rooms push downtime to weeks.
Data & Identity Blind Spots
No live intelligence — left hunting for answers post-attack with no easy way to surgically recover identity systems.
✓Future State · Rubrik
True Single Management Plane
Unify your entire data protection world with one intuitive command center designed to drastically reduce daily friction.
Cloud Takeover Resistance
Effortlessly recover using a logically air-gapped platform specifically engineered to survive compromised cloud environments.
Cyber Recovery Orchestration
Self-learning intelligence maps the blast radius, allowing precise one-shot recovery of the entire stack.
Data & Identity Posture Management
Continuous live intelligence locks down sensitive data pre-attack and pinpoints clean states for surgical identity recovery.
Sizing Assumptions
Inputs and ground rules underlying the Rubrik solution sizing for CPChem.
☁Cloud Workloads
  • Azure VMs in Protection — 505 VMs, 545TB allocated (50% consumed for UCL Licensing = 275TB)
  • Azure SQL & SQL Managed Instances — 6.1TB
  • Azure File Shares — 16TB
  • Azure VMs & SQL/MI protected by Exo-compute & Immutable Object Storage
  • Azure Files, SQL & SAP HANA backups protected by Azure Cloud Cluster
  • Frequency & Retention — Daily for 30 days · Immutable tiering to Rubrik Cloud Vault
⚙Frequency, Retention & Growth
  • Frequency & Retention — Daily for 30 days
  • Instant Archiving — up to 14 days for production workloads
  • Data Reduction — 2.8:1 for VMs and SQL Databases · 1.2:1 for NAS (Azure Files)
  • Annual Growth — 10% · Sized for 3 years
🛡OT & ICS Systems
OT and ICS workloads at each site are absorbed into that site's IT cluster unless either OT or ICS exceeds the 7.0 TB Small Site Threshold — in which case a dedicated cluster is provisioned to host the combined OT + ICS workload at that site.
